name: travelplanner-server
description: Secure backend API for AI Travel Agent powered by Gemini API

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/db/migrations', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('src/db/schema.sql')) fs.copyFileSync('src/db/schema.sql', 'dist/db/schema.sql'); if(fs.existsSync('src/db/migrations')) for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src/db/migrations')) fs.copyFileSync('src/db/migrations/'+f, 'dist/db/migrations/'+f);"
